subject: lava-lamps
title: Lava lamps: the original benchmark
note: The owner's first asset challenge: three lamps from basic to as real as possible. L1 is opaque lathe shapes with glowing colour, L2 adds a metal base, a glass shell over tinted liquid and a point light, L3 is a ray-marched lava material with refraction and merging wax. The first frame (all three lamps) is byte-identical to docs/fidelity/lava_lamps_m0_original.png.
